theorems.name: Submission.adr_invariant_eq_indicator
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n Q : ℕ) (ψ : Euclid P → Euclid Q) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), LocallyIntegrable ψ μH[(n : ℝ)] → n ≤ Module.finrank ℝ L → (∀ y ∈ L, ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ x, ψ (y + lam • x) = ψ x) → ∃ L' : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ L' = n ∧ ψ = Set.indicator (L' : Set (Euclid P)) (fun _ => ψ 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
